source.title: Data Model for Injection Molding and Blow Molding

process_separation.source_rule: I/INY-prefixed machine identifiers are injection moulding; S/SOP-prefixed identifiers are blow moulding, consistent with the associated peer-reviewed article.

missingness.interpretation: The downloaded v1 workbook contains no cells matching MouldMaster missing-value tokens in the 4,502 x 26 injection subset. This does not prove the original pre-publication records had no missing values: the associated study reports replacing null values with zero during modelling preprocessing. MouldMaster does not reverse-engineer or reinterpret zeros as missing without source evidence.

evidence_gaps: Production-order/run-level data are not assumed to be shot-resolved.
No controlled intervention or recovery sequence is established by this benchmark.
No cavity-pressure, cavity-temperature or other discriminating in-mould trace is established by this benchmark.
Historical process records do not establish a validated setting window or universal production recipe.
Correlation with reject, flash or defect metrics does not establish physical root cause.
Commanded/target versus actual semantics remain unresolved for process variables unless source documentation explicitly establishes them.
boundary: This result validates parts of MouldMaster's measured-data pathway only. It is not an authorised site pilot, root-cause proof, validated process window, production setting recommendation or production-change authority.
